text:
Aachen’s median asking rent stands at 11.57 €/m², up 2.6 % YoY and 24.1 % over the past five years, placing the city 18th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.7 % and an average of 26 days on market; 26 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is tight: the typical 60 m² unit costs 694 € per month, while rent‑burden for two residents is 16.3 %. Asking rents sit 61 % above existing rents (7.2 €/m²), reflecting a premium that limits broader access.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 12.28 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.9 €/m² and 12.59 €/m² – a 6.1 % increase.
